text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Ah, whoops. I just came out for a little run in the mountains. I didn't mean to stay out this late.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey... what's that light up ahead?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: This is... the sanctuary.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Who are you, lady?!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text: In the sanctuary, wear holy robes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha... What da heck is going on?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross. Or should I call you,
Nishikino
Cross?

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
I will look into your soul. Who is the
Umamusume
whose spirit most resembles
yours?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What? Well that's a weird question.
Whose spirit
is like mine?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, I guess? She's ambitious, like me.
I coulda
told ya that, though.

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the surface, the one most like
you is...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hi, Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's right. You and I... We are alike.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What?! Rudolf?! What do we have in
common?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We're totally different in every way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You know, I think we're pretty similar.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're really speedy across the finish
line, but
deep down, you and I share the
same competitive
spirit! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You too, Teio?! Are ya outta your mind?!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
And then there is she who goes by the
name
"Dark Lord of Destruction."

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
But the Umamusume whose spirit most
resembles
yours is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide?! You and me are meant to be
similar?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We are. You and I are like two sides of
an
equation. That is to say...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We are united by the equal sign. It's
simple
arithmetic. Symmetry of the soul.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Da heck?! Quit speaking gibberish! I
don't know a
thing about equations and
math and all that stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's Oguri who's like me! And maybe
Inari, too!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
You only scratch the surface. The soul
cannot be
measured in such shallow
metrics.

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Accept yourself. This is who you really
are!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh! You gotta be kidding me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(This is so annoying! I don't wanna
believe what
she's tellin' me, but...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(My head! I can't get it out of my head!
So now
what?)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, good idea. I'll do a hard workout
when I
get back.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll forget aaall about it. This has to
be a
dream. Some kinda stupid dream!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... How was that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is running differently
today. She
almost looks as if she's
running away from
something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you in the middle of a training
session?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to interrupt, but would you mind if
I used
one half of the track for my
practice?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Y-y-you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There you go again with your math!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Tamamo?! What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! No matter how far I run, I can't
get away
from you and your big-brain
equations! My head!
My head! We're not
the saaame!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What?! My head's not that much bigger
than
yours? Tamamo, wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo runs away as fast as her legs
can carry
her. She's abnormally fast and
her face looks pale.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. Better not waste any
more
time here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I needa leave before I get too wrapped
up in this
nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaagh! Get me outta here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... How was my time on the ramps?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But what?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You took my time on the way
down? What's
the point in that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm... that does make sense, though.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just, you could say I got some
ramp
practice on a mountain the other
day.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It was pretty intense, but I think I got
the hang of
runnin' downhill from it. At
least somethin' good
came from that
mess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not clear what happened to her, but
it seems
like she managed to gain
something from a bad
experience.
